title: CI dependency caches and history
summary: The shared runner, full-CI contract job and selection plan install uv through commit-pinned setup-uv with its download/build cache enabled and keyed on uv.lock. Each job creates its own locked environment; pip caching is removed. Full-CI test_shard and reuse_coverage use blobless full-history checkouts, retaining tags and commits for setuptools-scm, git tests and profile lineage. PostgreSQL host client prerequisites remain required. After Python and uv setup, ci_runner_prepare runs prerequisite installation, locked dependency sync and Postgres startup concurrently, then joins every bounded task before readiness, CREATEDB and tests. Its imports work without installed dependencies; named task failures block admission and retain the published cleanup path.
